title: Sub-Zero 16x
description: This is a PvP pack focused on performance and QoL.
body:
![Sub-Zero 16x](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/fbd2e4f56974dfa2086868337240f53337bfe84c.png)

This is a resource pack that includes QoL features and focuses on PvP components.
**Here is a list of things that are included in this pack:**

- Transparent GUI and HUD
- Custom Sound Effects
- Custom Item and Armor Textures
- Smaller Utilities
- Smaller Shield
- No Fishing Rod Bobber Overlay
- Low Fire
- Custom Font

Here is some information about the 16x and minimal versions:

- Minimal version does not use custom block, GUI, or item textures
- Minimal version keeps a more vanilla feel compared to the 16x version
- All QoL features are kept in the Minimal version
- The 16x version is made for maximum performance

You can find the minimal version **[here](https://modrinth.com/project/sub-zero-minimal)**.

You are allowed to make forks of this pack (If so, give me credit), **YOU MAY NOT RESELL THIS PACK!**
